## ℹ️ What to Know About Family Dispute Resolution (FDR)

Before initiating court proceedings in the family court, parties are generally required to attempt FDR with a neutral third party. If the parenting dispute is not going to family law court, then FDR is voluntary. FDR is designed to resolve custody matters out of court.
It is strongly advisable to consult with an **Accredited Family Law Specialist** (look for the Queensland Law Society accreditation) when dealing with parenting disputes, as
the Family Law Act has changed many times over the years, making it difficult for people with no legal experience to understand the legalities involved in a child custody dispute.
